description:

title: SAP ABAP Developer – SAP PM & Mobility
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SAP ABAP Developer – SAP PM & Mobility em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atuar na configuração e manutenção de soluções mobile utilizando SYCLO Dynamic Forms e/ou SAP Service Asset Manager (SSAM).
  • Desenvolver e sustentar soluções utilizando ABAP para integração e customização de processos SAP.
  • Desenvolver e consumir serviços OData para integração entre aplicações SAP e plataformas mobile.
  • Atuar na manutenção e gestão de dados mestres de manutenção, incluindo:
  • Equipment.
  • Classification.
  • Estruturas e tabelas relacionadas.
  • Atuar em processos de manutenção preventiva no SAP PM, incluindo:
  • Maintenance Plans.
  • Maintenance Items.
  • Maintenance Task Lists.
  • Estruturas e tabelas relacionadas.
  • Realizar análises técnicas, correções e melhorias em processos de manutenção e mobilidade SAP.
  • Participar do desenvolvimento e sustentação de integrações entre aplicações SAP e sistemas corporativos.
  • Executar troubleshooting, identificação de falhas e suporte técnico em ambientes produtivos.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes funcionais e técnicas para implementação de melhorias e novas funcionalidades.
  • Participar de atividades de documentação técnica e disseminação de conhecimento dentro da equipe.
  • Atuar em ambientes multiculturais com comunicação frequente em inglês.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com configuração SYCLO Dynamic Forms e/ou SAP Service Asset Manager (SSAM).
  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento ABAP.
  • Conhecimento em serviços e integrações OData.
  • Experiência com SAP PM (Plant Maintenance).
  • Conhecimento em Maintenance Master Data.
  • Experiência em processos de manutenção preventiva
  • Tabelas relacionadas.
  • Conhecimento em integrações e arquitetura SAP.
  • Experiência em análise, troubleshooting e suporte de aplicações SAP.
  • Vivência com desenvolvimento, manutenção e sustentação de soluções corporativas.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente (OBRIGATÓRIO).


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com SAP Mobile Services.
  • Conhecimento em integrações SAP com aplicações mobile corporativas.
  • Vivência em ambientes industriais, manufatura ou utilities.
  • Experiência com processos de manutenção corretiva e preventiva em SAP PM.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de integração SAP.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou similares).
  • Vivência em ambientes multiculturais e equipes globais.

title: LATAM / Senior Functional Infrastructure Engineer (TypeScript / Integrations)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para LATAM / Senior Functional Infrastructure Engineer (TypeScript / Integrations) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Description

We are hiring a Senior Functional Backend Engineer to help us connect to insurance portals across the U.S. to ingest, transform, and deliver structured healthcare data, including claims, EOBs, plan documents, and accumulators.


This role sits at the intersection of production reliability and system design . You’ll own integration health in production, onboard new portals, expand data coverage, and write clean, strongly typed backend code. The team values functional principles such as composability, explicit error handling, type safety, and uses Effect extensively, but prior experience with Effect is not required.


This is hands-on engineering in a system where correctness and clarity matter.


English fluency is a MUST for this role! Only candidates with level C1 or C2 will be considered:


A1 Beginner

A2 Elementary

B1 Intermediate

B2 Upper-Intermediate

C1 Advanced

C2 Proficient


Responsibilities
  • Production Triage & Reliability
  • Own first-response triage for portal integration failures
  • Debug login automation issues, crawl failures, and ingestion errors
  • Trace failures across logs, workflows, and monitoring systems
  • Implement clean, durable fixes - not just patches
  • Escalate systemic platform issues when appropriate
  • Portal Onboarding
  • Bring new insurance portals into production
  • Reverse-engineer APIs and browser workflows
  • Build ingestion pipelines and validate structured outputs
  • Ensure integrations remain resilient as portals evolve
  • Data Expansion  
  • Extend existing integrations to capture new data types
  • Maintain strong typing and predictable transformations
  • Guard against schema drift and data inconsistencies
  • Collaboration
  • Contribute to runbooks and documentation
  • Participate in async standups and structured handoffs
  • Work closely with a platform-focused engineering team


Requirements
  • 4+ years of Strongly Typed Backend Experience  
  • Deep experience in strongly typed languages (TypeScript , Scala, Kotlin , Go, etc.)
  • Careful API modeling and schema validation
  • Comfort designing systems where types act as contracts
  • Functional or Declarative Programming Experience  
  • You don’t need to come from a pure Functional Programming background, but you should be comfortable with immutability, explicit handling, declarative composition, and writing predictable, testable code.
  • AI Integration Experience: Accelerate developers and internal operations by exposing or configuring API and MCP access to our infrastructure, while keeping costs and security under control.
  • CI/CD Operations Experience: Ability to improve GitHub Actions workflows, implement faster CI runners, enhance caching strategies, and manage multi-environment deployments (dev/prod) using Pulumi
  • Infrastructure Management with AWS: Maintain AWS infrastructure including ECS, Aurora RDS (Gel), VPC networking, and monitoring stack (OpenTelemetry, Honeycomb, Sentry → but soon Datadog), and AWS access provisioning
  • TypeScript (Backend)
  • Enhance our TypeScript monorepo performance, optimize the Nx build system, migrate from CommonJS to ESM, and improve our Docker-based DevContainers


Nice To Have
  • Experience with Effect
  • Experience with Effect is a strong plus
  • If not, you should be comfortable learning it and working within a composable, typed effect system
  • Playwright or browser automation
  • API reverse-engineering via browser devtools
  • Workflow orchestration (Temporal or similar)
  • Data ingestion or transformation pipelines
  • Observability tooling (Datadog or similar)
  • MDM & Security & Compliance: Support HIPAA compliance initiatives, including RBAC implementation, encryption standards, and security monitoring
  • Experience in the Healthcare industry in the USA

title: Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer


Job Purpose

As Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer, you are the technical anchor for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform — a multi-client environment hosted on AWS. The work is grounded in deep Windows Server operations: Active Directory, IIS, hybrid identity, Group Policy, PowerShell, certificate services, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.


AWS is the platform on which all of this runs. Comfort with the cloud layer matters and you will operate it daily, but it is the Microsoft stack — and its operational nuance — that defines this role. We hire for deep Windows expertise first; the cloud layer is something a strong sysadmin can absorb.


The estate is Windows Server 2019 and above, end-to-end. Linux footprint is negligible — this is a role for someone who wants to go deep on the Microsoft stack rather than be spread thin across platforms.


This is a 100% individual contributor role. You will not manage or lead a team. You will own complex incidents end-to-end, set technical standards by example, and act as the senior escalation point for the Cloud Support function.


Role Responsibilities

  • Lead resolution of complex Windows Server incidents across multi-client, AWS-hosted environments — from triage to root cause to remediation.
  • Administer and harden Windows Server 2019/2022/2025: Active Directory (forest/domain design, replication, FSMO, GPOs, trusts), DNS, DHCP, IIS, WSUS, AD CS, file & print services.
  • Operate hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ AWS Managed Microsoft AD, federation with Entra ID (Azure AD) / AD FS, SAML / OIDC / OAuth, Kerberos, MFA.
  • Author and maintain PowerShell automation: bulk administration, scheduled tasks, configuration drift correction, reporting, and DSC where appropriate.
  • Operate the AWS hosting layer for Windows workloads: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command), Backup, Directory Service.
  • Manage IIS in depth: sites, application pools, bindings, ARR / URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, and performance tuning.
  • Drive observability of the Windows estate: event log strategy, performance baselines, CloudWatch metrics & alarms, Grafana dashboards.
  • Author runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to codify operational standards.
  • Participate in ITIL incident, problem, and change management; act as senior on-call escalation.


Essential Skills & Experience

Windows Server & Microsoft Infrastructure (Primary)

  • 7+ years operating Windows Server in production, with deep hands-on experience on Windows Server 2019 and above.
  • Active Directory at depth: forest/domain design, replication, FSMO roles, trusts, sites & services, schema, tombstone & recovery.
  • Group Policy at scale: design, troubleshooting (RSoP, gpresult), security baselines, WMI filtering.
  • IIS at depth: site & app pool configuration, ARR, URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, performance tuning.
  • DNS, DHCP, WSUS, and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) — real operational experience.
  • Advanced PowerShell: scripting, modules, remoting, error handling, automation patterns, DSC familiarity.
  • Windows patching at scale: planning, deployment, rollback, and troubleshooting in regulated environments.
  • Windows performance troubleshooting: PerfMon, ETW, memory dump analysis, IIS request diagnostics.

Identity & Authentication

  • Hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ cloud, Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect / federation, AD FS.
  • SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, Kerberos, LDAP, MFA — practical implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Certificate management and PKI in enterprise Windows environments.

AWS Hosting Platform (Operational Competence)

  • Day-to-day comfort operating Windows workloads in AWS: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch.
  • AWS Systems Manager for Windows fleet management: Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command, State Manager, Parameter Store.
  • AWS Directory Service / Managed Microsoft AD / AD Connector.

Note: Deep AWS architect-level expertise is not required. We hire for Windows depth; the cloud layer is the platform, and we expect strong fundamentals plus willingness to grow.

Service Operations & Remote Working

  • Strong ITIL grounding: incident, problem, change, and service lifecycle management.
  • Prior experience in an MSP or shared-services environment — multiple client estates managed under SLA.
  • Advanced / fluent professional English, written and spoken.
  • Reliable, distraction-free home office with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video setup.
  • Ability to work New York-aligned hours consistently, with the same presence and responsiveness as an office-based colleague.

Working Hours, Remote Setup & Engagement

This role is 100% remote and 100% individual contributor. To match the responsiveness of an office-based engineer:

  • Working hours: You will operate aligned to New York business hours (08:30–17:30 ET). Typical Brazil hours: 09:30–18:30 BRT during EDT (US summer) and 10:30–19:30 BRT during EST (US winter). You must be online, responsive, and actively engaged throughout core hours, the same as if you were sat with the team in the office.
  • Home office: Quiet, ergonomic workspace with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video / audio setup. This is not a digital-nomad role.
  • Engagement model: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) or via Employer of Record — confirmed during recruitment. Tax, invoicing, and benefits arrangements discussed at offer stage.
  • Equipment & expenses: Discussed at offer stage.
  • On-call: Participation in a senior escalation rota for major incidents — compensated in line with policy.

title: LATAM / Senior Functional Infrastructure Engineer (TypeScript / Integrations)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para LATAM / Senior Functional Infrastructure Engineer (TypeScript / Integrations) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Description

We are hiring a Senior Functional Backend Engineer to help us connect to insurance portals across the U.S. to ingest, transform, and deliver structured healthcare data, including claims, EOBs, plan documents, and accumulators.


This role sits at the intersection of production reliability and system design . You’ll own integration health in production, onboard new portals, expand data coverage, and write clean, strongly typed backend code. The team values functional principles such as composability, explicit error handling, type safety, and uses Effect extensively, but prior experience with Effect is not required.


This is hands-on engineering in a system where correctness and clarity matter.


English fluency is a MUST for this role! Only candidates with level C1 or C2 will be considered:


A1 Beginner

A2 Elementary

B1 Intermediate

B2 Upper-Intermediate

C1 Advanced

C2 Proficient


Responsibilities
  • Production Triage & Reliability
  • Own first-response triage for portal integration failures
  • Debug login automation issues, crawl failures, and ingestion errors
  • Trace failures across logs, workflows, and monitoring systems
  • Implement clean, durable fixes - not just patches
  • Escalate systemic platform issues when appropriate
  • Portal Onboarding
  • Bring new insurance portals into production
  • Reverse-engineer APIs and browser workflows
  • Build ingestion pipelines and validate structured outputs
  • Ensure integrations remain resilient as portals evolve
  • Data Expansion  
  • Extend existing integrations to capture new data types
  • Maintain strong typing and predictable transformations
  • Guard against schema drift and data inconsistencies
  • Collaboration
  • Contribute to runbooks and documentation
  • Participate in async standups and structured handoffs
  • Work closely with a platform-focused engineering team


Requirements
  • 4+ years of Strongly Typed Backend Experience  
  • Deep experience in strongly typed languages (TypeScript , Scala, Kotlin , Go, etc.)
  • Careful API modeling and schema validation
  • Comfort designing systems where types act as contracts
  • Functional or Declarative Programming Experience  
  • You don’t need to come from a pure Functional Programming background, but you should be comfortable with immutability, explicit handling, declarative composition, and writing predictable, testable code.
  • AI Integration Experience: Accelerate developers and internal operations by exposing or configuring API and MCP access to our infrastructure, while keeping costs and security under control.
  • CI/CD Operations Experience: Ability to improve GitHub Actions workflows, implement faster CI runners, enhance caching strategies, and manage multi-environment deployments (dev/prod) using Pulumi
  • Infrastructure Management with AWS: Maintain AWS infrastructure including ECS, Aurora RDS (Gel), VPC networking, and monitoring stack (OpenTelemetry, Honeycomb, Sentry → but soon Datadog), and AWS access provisioning
  • TypeScript (Backend)
  • Enhance our TypeScript monorepo performance, optimize the Nx build system, migrate from CommonJS to ESM, and improve our Docker-based DevContainers


Nice To Have
  • Experience with Effect
  • Experience with Effect is a strong plus
  • If not, you should be comfortable learning it and working within a composable, typed effect system
  • Playwright or browser automation
  • API reverse-engineering via browser devtools
  • Workflow orchestration (Temporal or similar)
  • Data ingestion or transformation pipelines
  • Observability tooling (Datadog or similar)
  • MDM & Security & Compliance: Support HIPAA compliance initiatives, including RBAC implementation, encryption standards, and security monitoring
  • Experience in the Healthcare industry in the USA

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

We are looking for a Talent Data Analyst to join our Talent team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data from our Talent team, extract insights, and help solve problems.

- Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.

- Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Data Analysis tools, developing reports according to analyst-defined specifications.

- Maintain and document the operational environment.

- An understanding of top-of-the-line Data Analysis tools. Previous experience with administration, licensing, security, and deployment is a plus.

- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.

- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.

- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

title: Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer


Job Purpose

As Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer, you are the technical anchor for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform — a multi-client environment hosted on AWS. The work is grounded in deep Windows Server operations: Active Directory, IIS, hybrid identity, Group Policy, PowerShell, certificate services, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.


AWS is the platform on which all of this runs. Comfort with the cloud layer matters and you will operate it daily, but it is the Microsoft stack — and its operational nuance — that defines this role. We hire for deep Windows expertise first; the cloud layer is something a strong sysadmin can absorb.


The estate is Windows Server 2019 and above, end-to-end. Linux footprint is negligible — this is a role for someone who wants to go deep on the Microsoft stack rather than be spread thin across platforms.


This is a 100% individual contributor role. You will not manage or lead a team. You will own complex incidents end-to-end, set technical standards by example, and act as the senior escalation point for the Cloud Support function.


Role Responsibilities

  • Lead resolution of complex Windows Server incidents across multi-client, AWS-hosted environments — from triage to root cause to remediation.
  • Administer and harden Windows Server 2019/2022/2025: Active Directory (forest/domain design, replication, FSMO, GPOs, trusts), DNS, DHCP, IIS, WSUS, AD CS, file & print services.
  • Operate hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ AWS Managed Microsoft AD, federation with Entra ID (Azure AD) / AD FS, SAML / OIDC / OAuth, Kerberos, MFA.
  • Author and maintain PowerShell automation: bulk administration, scheduled tasks, configuration drift correction, reporting, and DSC where appropriate.
  • Operate the AWS hosting layer for Windows workloads: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command), Backup, Directory Service.
  • Manage IIS in depth: sites, application pools, bindings, ARR / URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, and performance tuning.
  • Drive observability of the Windows estate: event log strategy, performance baselines, CloudWatch metrics & alarms, Grafana dashboards.
  • Author runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to codify operational standards.
  • Participate in ITIL incident, problem, and change management; act as senior on-call escalation.


Essential Skills & Experience

Windows Server & Microsoft Infrastructure (Primary)

  • 7+ years operating Windows Server in production, with deep hands-on experience on Windows Server 2019 and above.
  • Active Directory at depth: forest/domain design, replication, FSMO roles, trusts, sites & services, schema, tombstone & recovery.
  • Group Policy at scale: design, troubleshooting (RSoP, gpresult), security baselines, WMI filtering.
  • IIS at depth: site & app pool configuration, ARR, URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, performance tuning.
  • DNS, DHCP, WSUS, and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) — real operational experience.
  • Advanced PowerShell: scripting, modules, remoting, error handling, automation patterns, DSC familiarity.
  • Windows patching at scale: planning, deployment, rollback, and troubleshooting in regulated environments.
  • Windows performance troubleshooting: PerfMon, ETW, memory dump analysis, IIS request diagnostics.

Identity & Authentication

  • Hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ cloud, Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect / federation, AD FS.
  • SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, Kerberos, LDAP, MFA — practical implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Certificate management and PKI in enterprise Windows environments.

AWS Hosting Platform (Operational Competence)

  • Day-to-day comfort operating Windows workloads in AWS: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch.
  • AWS Systems Manager for Windows fleet management: Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command, State Manager, Parameter Store.
  • AWS Directory Service / Managed Microsoft AD / AD Connector.

Note: Deep AWS architect-level expertise is not required. We hire for Windows depth; the cloud layer is the platform, and we expect strong fundamentals plus willingness to grow.

Service Operations & Remote Working

  • Strong ITIL grounding: incident, problem, change, and service lifecycle management.
  • Prior experience in an MSP or shared-services environment — multiple client estates managed under SLA.
  • Advanced / fluent professional English, written and spoken.
  • Reliable, distraction-free home office with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video setup.
  • Ability to work New York-aligned hours consistently, with the same presence and responsiveness as an office-based colleague.

Working Hours, Remote Setup & Engagement

This role is 100% remote and 100% individual contributor. To match the responsiveness of an office-based engineer:

  • Working hours: You will operate aligned to New York business hours (08:30–17:30 ET). Typical Brazil hours: 09:30–18:30 BRT during EDT (US summer) and 10:30–19:30 BRT during EST (US winter). You must be online, responsive, and actively engaged throughout core hours, the same as if you were sat with the team in the office.
  • Home office: Quiet, ergonomic workspace with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video / audio setup. This is not a digital-nomad role.
  • Engagement model: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) or via Employer of Record — confirmed during recruitment. Tax, invoicing, and benefits arrangements discussed at offer stage.
  • Equipment & expenses: Discussed at offer stage.
  • On-call: Participation in a senior escalation rota for major incidents — compensated in line with policy.

title: AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese )
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese ) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description:

MillionLogics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, MillionLogics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results.


Role Overview:

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Offer Details:

  • Duration of Contract : 6 months
  • Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home)
  • Mode of work: Fully Remote
  • Number of Positions: 20
  • Must have fluency in Portgutal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese )



Skills:

  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.
  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency : Ability to read and write in Portgutal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese ) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied.
  • Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.



Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Additional Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 6 months

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Java Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A VMetrix é uma plataforma SaaS que atende instituições financeiras na América Latina. Processamos fluxos transacionais complexos, pipelines de dados de alto volume e integrações em tempo real — tudo construído sobre uma stack Java/Spring Boot + Oracle implantada na Oracle Cloud. Buscamos desenvolvedores Java sólidos que escrevam código excelente, pensem em sistemas e adotem o desenvolvimento assistido por IA como parte central do seu fluxo de trabalho.


Propósito do Cargo

Como Senior Java Developer , você vai construir e manter serviços backend e módulos de plataforma que suportam operações críticas de negócio. Você não precisa de experiência prévia no domínio financeiro — nós ensinamos. O que precisamos é de um desenvolvedor que escreva Java limpo e performante, domine padrões de design, entenda sistemas distribuídos e use ferramentas como Claude Code para se mover rápido sem sacrificar qualidade.


Responsabilidades Principais:

Desenvolvimento Backend

  • Projetar, construir e manter serviços backend em Java 8+/Spring Boot: APIs REST, jobs de processamento batch, pipelines de transformação de dados e camadas de integração.
  • Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe.
  • Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção.
  • Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput.
  • Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas.


Design e Arquitetura

  • Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios.
  • Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos.
  • Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos.
  • Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas.


Banco de Dados e Integrações

  • Trabalhar com Oracle Database: escrever e otimizar consultas SQL, stored procedures e packages PL/SQL para operações intensivas em dados.
  • Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados.
  • Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais.
  • Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas.


Infraestrutura e Deploy

  • Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações WebLogic.
  • Trabalhar com pipelines CI/CD (GitLab CI ou similar) para fluxos automatizados de build, teste e deployment.
  • Diagnosticar problemas em produção: analisar logs, métricas de aplicação e comportamento do sistema para resolver incidentes.


Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA

  • Usar Claude Code como ferramenta principal de desenvolvimento: geração de código, refatoração, debugging, escrita de testes e exploração de codebases desconhecidos.
  • Escrever e manter documentação técnica em Markdown que sirva como contexto de alta qualidade tanto para ferramentas de IA quanto para a equipe.
  • Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA.
  • Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas.


Colaboração e Crescimento

  • Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento.
  • Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.
  • 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento Java.
  • Domínio sólido de Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, concorrência, collections, Optional, API de data/hora) e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, segurança, Spring Data, testes).
  • Conhecimento sólido de padrões de design GoF (criacionais, estruturais, comportamentais) e capacidade de aplicá-los corretamente conforme o contexto do problema.
  • Domínio dos princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS e YAGNI na prática diária de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com design orientado a objetos: modelagem de domínios, composição vs herança, encapsulamento, tratamento de exceções e design de APIs internas claras.
  • Habilidades sólidas em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais: otimização de queries, estratégias de indexação, joins complexos, gerenciamento transacional. Experiência com Oracle é um diferencial forte.
  • Experiência com estratégias de testes: testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito), testes de integração, test doubles e TDD ou BDD como prática habitual.
  • Experiência com deploys em contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes (qualquer distribuição), pipelines CI/CD.
  • Familiaridade com fluxos Git (Git Flow ou trunk-based), Postman/OpenAPI para desenvolvimento de APIs.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA — especialmente Claude Code. Esperamos que você use IA diariamente como multiplicador de produtividade, não como muleta.
  • Comunicação escrita sólida: capacidade de produzir specs técnicos claros, documentos de design e descrições de PR.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com Oracle PL/SQL: stored procedures, pipelined functions, performance tuning.
  • Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura: caching (Caffeine/Redis), arquitetura event-driven, design metadata-driven, CQRS.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços ou modular monolith: estratégias de comunicação entre serviços, gerenciamento de transações distribuídas, contract testing.
  • Familiaridade com Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture ou Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade: Grafana, Prometheus, métricas de aplicação, agregação de logs.
  • Familiaridade com servidor de aplicações WebLogic ou runtimes Java empresariais similares.
  • Experiência trabalhando em plataformas SaaS ou sistemas multi-tenant.
  • Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.


O Que Valorizamos:

  • Qualidade acima de velocidade: preferimos entregar código limpo e bem testado um dia depois do que debugar um desastre por uma semana.
  • Fluência com IA: você vê Claude Code e ferramentas similares como partes essenciais do seu toolkit, não como novidades. Sabe quando confiar no output e quando questioná-lo.
  • Critério de design: você não aplica padrões por inércia — sabe quando um Strategy simplifica e quando um if-else é suficiente. Prioriza clareza acima de cleverness.
  • Pensamento sistêmico: considera os efeitos downstream das suas decisões de design em desempenho, manutenibilidade e velocidade da equipe.
  • Ownership: leva suas features do design até produção e se importa com como seu código se comporta no mundo real.
  • Curiosidade: se mantém atualizado com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento, e tem interesse genuíno em evoluir no seu ofício.
  • Comunicação clara: escreve documentação que seus colegas de equipe (e as ferramentas de IA) realmente conseguem usar.


Processo de Candidatura:

  • Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo .
  • Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo.
  • Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência.
  • Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não.


Por que trabalhar na VMetrix

Na VMetrix , não buscamos “fazer mais barulho”, mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva.

Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional.

Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

Responsável por toda a cadeia produtiva de panificação, desde o recebimento e armazenamento de insumos congelados até a finalização e exposição dos produtos na área de venda. O Padeiro atua como garantidor da qualidade, segurança alimentar e eficiência operacional da padaria, assegurando que cada item chegue ao cliente com o padrão de frescor e apresentação exigido pela Emporyum Prime.


Responsabilidades Principais

Gestão de Insumos

● Receber, conferir e armazenar pães congelados e demais insumos de padaria, respeitando as temperaturas e prazos de validade indicados pelos fornecedores

● Organizar o estoque seguindo o princípio PVPS (Primeiro que Vence, Primeiro que Sai), garantindo a rotatividade adequada dos produtos

● Registrar lotes e datas de recebimento para rastreabilidade e controle sanitário

Processo Produtivo

● Conduzir o processo de fermentação natural e câmara de crescimento, respeitando os tempos, temperaturas e condições ambientais especificados para cada tipo de massa

● Operar fornos industriais com precisão nos parâmetros de temperatura, umidade e tempo de assamento

● Monitorar indicadores visuais e sensoriais (coloração, textura, aroma) para garantir o ponto ideal de cada fornada antes da disponibilização para venda

Produção Diversificada

● Elaborar salgados assados e fritos (coxinhas, empadas, esfihas, quibes, folheados) seguindo receituário padrão e especificações de peso e formato

● Produzir doces de padaria (bolos, tortas, biscoitos, sonhos, brigadeiros, pudins) com consistência de sabor, textura e apresentação

● Executar decoração básica e finalização de produtos confeitados para vitrine

Gestão de Estoque e Controle de Perdas

● Realizar inventário diário de insumos e produtos acabados, registrando entradas, saídas e quebras

● Monitorar e reportar o KPI de perda (percentual de desperdício sobre produção total), propondo ações corretivas quando o indicador ultrapassar o limite estabelecido

● Identificar produtos próximos ao vencimento e acionar a área comercial para estratégias de giro rápido (promoções, combos, doações internas)

Exposição

● Repor e organizar as gôndolas e vitrines de venda, garantindo sortimento visual equilibrado e exposição atrativa dos produtos

● Manter etiquetas de preço, informações de validade e identificação de alergênicos visíveis e atualizados

● Assegurar que a área de padaria esteja limpa, organizada e em conformidade com as normas sanitárias (ANVISA/BPF) durante todo o horário de funcionamento


Requisitos e Habilidades Desejadas

Escolaridade

● Ensino fundamental completo (obrigatório)

● Curso técnico em Panificação, Confeitaria ou Gastronomia (desejável)

Experiência

● Mínimo de 1 ano em funções de padaria, panificação ou confeitaria

● Experiência comprovada com fermentação natural, fornos industriais e produção em escala

● Vivência em estabelecimentos de alimentação com alto padrão de qualidade (diferencial)

Habilidades Essenciais

Competência

Por que é importante

Organização e disciplina operacional

O processo produtivo exige sequenciamento preciso de etapas (fermentação, modelagem, assamento) — um desvio quebra o fluxo e compromete a disponibilidade de produtos na loja

Atenção a normas sanitárias

A manipulação direta de alimentos exige rigor absoluto com higiene, temperaturas e boas práticas de fabricação para garantir a segurança do consumidor e a conformidade legal

Capacidade de trabalho sob pressão

O ritmo de produção é determinado pela demanda da loja — horários de pico exigem agilidade sem abrir mão da qualidade

Precisão e consistência técnica

Cada fornada deve reproduzir o padrão estabelecido — variações em peso, ponto de cozimento ou apresentação afetam diretamente a experiência do cliente e a margem de perda

Proatividade e senso de dono

O Padeiro é o guardião do estoque e do desperdício — antecipar necessidades de insumos e agir sobre produtos próximos ao vencimento reduz perdas e melhora a rentabilidade

Diferenciais

● Conhecimento em confeitaria fina e decoração de bolos

● Experiência com massas especiais (fermentação longa, massa madre, integrais, sem glúten)

● Disponibilidade para horários flexíveis (incluindo finais de semana e feriados)

● CNH categoria A ou B (para eventual deslocamento entre unidades)

● Curso de Boas Práticas de Fabricação e Manipulação de Alimentos atualizado

Join us and change the world.

This is a senior-level engineering role with a strong backend focus, combining modern full-stack development with AI-powered application development. You will be responsible for architecting and building scalable systems, establishing development standards, integrating Generative AI solutions into production environments, and driving technical decisions across multiple initiatives.


The role is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguous environments, enjoys building systems from scratch, and can operate as a highly autonomous technical leader while collaborating closely with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders.

Low ego, low drama, servant leader: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea.


One team mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone.


Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve — our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen.


Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you.


Player-coach: You fly high and low. You understand the strategy while staying close to the details that matter. You roll up your sleeves, stay hands-on, and empower others without micromanaging.


Business problem solver: You’re not just a functional expert; you approach your work through the lens of solving business problems.

Backend Architecture & Development


Design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems using .NET and C#.

Architect robust APIs, services, and application infrastructure that support current and future products.

Establish engineering standards, best practices, and maintainable system architectures.

Drive technical decisions that improve scalability, reliability, security, and performance.


Full-Stack Development

Contribute across the full stack when needed while maintaining a strong backend focus.

Ensure seamless integration between frontend experiences and backend services.

Support application modernization and continuous improvement initiatives.


AI & Generative AI Integration


Design and implement Generative AI solutions within production applications.

Evaluate and integrate LLM-powered capabilities that improve business processes and operational efficiency.

Build AI-enabled workflows, automation systems, and intelligent application features.

Stay current with emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to create business value.


Technical Leadership & Solution Design


Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership across projects.

Make informed technology decisions in environments with evolving requirements and limited structure.

Lead solution design discussions and identify the best approaches for implementation.

Drive engineering excellence through mentorship, documentation, and knowledge sharing.


Collaboration & Delivery


Work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

Partner with leadership to align technical strategy with business goals.

Participate in planning, estimation, prioritization, and delivery activities.

Ensure solutions are delivered with high quality and maintainability.


Qualifications & Competencies


Experience

8+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on backend development.

Extensive hands-on experience with .NET and C#.

Strong full-stack development experience with modern web application architectures.

Experience building and deploying production-grade applications.

Experience working in startup, scale-up, or high-growth environments.


AI & Modern Engineering

Proven experience integrating Generative AI solutions into production applications.

Hands-on experience working with LLMs, AI-powered workflows, or intelligent automation systems.

Understanding of AI orchestration patterns, agentic workflows, or AI application architecture.

Experience evaluating and implementing emerging AI technologies.


Technical Expertise

Strong knowledge of software architecture, system design, APIs, and distributed systems.

Experience designing scalable and maintainable backend services.

Deep understanding of modern development practices, testing strategies, and deployment workflows.

Strong problem-solving and debugging capabilities.


Leadership & Communication

Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.

Ability to operate independently and make high-impact technical decisions.

Comfortable navigating ambiguity and changing priorities.

Strong ownership mentality and accountability for outcomes.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Claude and AI orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience with AI agents, RAG architectures, or advanced LLM implementation patterns.
  • Experience building products or platforms from scratch.
  • Experience leading technical teams or serving as a technical lead.
  • Experience working in highly autonomous engineering environments.


What We’re Looking For


We're looking for someone who is more than a software developer.


The ideal candidate is a senior engineer who can own technical outcomes, architect scalable solutions, integrate AI into real-world products, and operate with minimal oversight.

You should be comfortable making architectural decisions, solving complex backend challenges, collaborating across functions, and leveraging AI technologies to create business impact.


This role is best suited for someone who is highly autonomous, technically strong, product-minded, and excited about building the future of AI-enabled software systems.

Contract Type : Contracting

Duration : 12 Months

Expected Start Date : 22 June 2026

Assessment Path : .NET

Apply Now


Apply now to join Andela's global talent network and support the development of next-generation AI-powered applications for a fast-growing technology-driven organization.


This is an excellent opportunity for a Senior Software Engineer, Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Lead Software Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Backend Engineer who enjoys modern architecture, AI-powered development, technical leadership, and building scalable systems from the ground up.

title: Arquiteto Cloud & DevOps Sênior
description:

Viva a experiência SONDA

Aqui você transforma sua carreira!



Por que fazer parte da SONDA?



Porque assim como você, amamos o que fazemos, temos paixão por inovação e estamos convencidos de que através do conhecimento e da tecnologia vamos transformar não só os negócios de nossos clientes, mas também o futuro.

  • Implementar e administrar soluções de segurança cloud, incluindo IAM, WAF, Security Groups, políticas de acesso, compliance e governança;

  • Garantir boas práticas de versionamento, workflows Git, gestão de repositórios e versionamento semântico;
  • Participar da definição de padrões arquiteturais, melhoria contínua e evolução tecnológica dos ambientes corporativos;
  • Criar e manter documentações técnicas, diagramas e padrões operacionais;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva e hands-on em ambientes críticos e de alta complexidade tecnológica.



Ideal se você tiver:

  • Formação de ensino superior cursando ou completo;
  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura, administração e sustentação de ambientes Cloud Multi-Cloud (AWS, Azure e GCP);
  • Vivência em projetos de infraestrutura cloud escalável, resiliente e segura;
  • Conhecimento avançado em DevOps, GitOps e automação de infraestrutura;
  • Experiência prática com CI/CD utilizando Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions e pipelines automatizados;
  • Forte experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) utilizando Terraform e CloudFormation;
  • Conhecimento em containers e orquestração com Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Amazon EKS e ECS;
  • Experiência em automação e integração via APIs para infraestrutura e operações;
  • Conhecimento em Linux, redes, SDN, armazenamento (SDS) e virtualização de containers;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento como CloudWatch, Prometheus e Grafana;
  • Experiência em troubleshooting e análise de incidentes em ambientes complexos;
  • Conhecimento em segurança cloud, IAM, WAF, Security Groups e boas práticas de governança;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados e serviços de dados em cloud;
  • Experiência com serviços AWS como Glue, Redshift e Kinesis;
  • Conhecimento em versionamento Git, workflows de repositórios, tags e versionamento semântico;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de automação e scripting como Python, Shell Script e JavaScript;
  • Capacidade analítica para resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para atuação colaborativa entre times multidisciplinares;
  • Perfil hands-on, proativo e orientado à melhoria contínua;
  • Facilidade para atuar em ambientes ágeis e dinâmicos.



Será considerando um diferencial:

  • Certificações AWS, como:
  • AWS Solutions Architect
  • AWS DevOps Engineer
  • AWS Security Specialist
  • Conhecimento em FinOps e otimização de custos cloud;
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a microsserviços;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de alta criticidade.



O que você pode esperar de nós?


  • Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.


O que oferecemos?


  • SONDA Academy: uma plataforma de aprendizado que busca maximizar seu desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Trabalho híbrido. Na SONDA sabemos que a flexibilidade é importante para o seu bem-estar, é por isso que contamos com jornadas presenciais e de teletrabalho.
  • SONDA Wellness, um programa que busca apoiá-lo no equilíbrio da sua vida pessoal e profissional, promovendo uma série de iniciativas focadas na sua saúde física, menta e social.
  • E muito mais!



+ Diversidade + Inclusão = Inovação e colaboração



Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. Sabermos que a diversidade é um elemento fundamental para impulsionar a inovação, é por isso que buscamos candidatos com base em suas qualificações profissionais, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, idade, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade ou deficiência.



Faça parte da nossa equipe!

title: Direct-Response Ad Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Direct-Response Ad Video Editor em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding.

You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day.

Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts.

This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements
  • Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll
  • Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build VelorHealth versions
  • Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs
  • Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do
  • Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated TikTok-style captions) depending on the ad format
  • Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing
  • Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours
  • Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates

What You Need

  • Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or TikTok with measurable results)
  • Fluency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in
  • Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native
  • Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught
  • Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography
  • Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought
  • A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly
  • Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed
  • Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person)

Bonus (Not Required)

  • Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space
  • Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production
  • Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation)

What You Don't Need

  • A film degree
  • A fancy reel of cinematic work
  • Experience at a big agency
  • Color grading expertise

We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you.

Compensation

Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work.

How To Apply

There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works:

  • Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or TikTok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before.
  • If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired.
  • We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference?
  • Did the first frame stop the scroll?
  • Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO?
  • Did you deliver on time?
  • If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output.

We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut.


To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para UX Designer - Remoto em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: UX Designer - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Auxílio creche

- Seguro de vida

- Acesso a plataforma de apoio psicossocial

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Atuação em projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência com UX/UI Design (Prototipação);
  • Experiência com rotinas da área de UX Writer;
  • Conhecimento sobre experiência do usuário e teste de usabilidade;
  • Vivência com UX Research;
  • Experiência no setor bancário;
  • Experiência com Metodologias Ágeis.


Formação: Superior completo.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: Talent Data Analyst - Remote
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Data Analyst - Remote em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Talent Data Analyst to join our Talent team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data from our Talent team, extract insights, and help solve problems.


Key responsibilities:


- Understand the Talent funnel and architect a Data solution from scratch, including the definition of KPIs and metrics.

- Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.

- Cleanse and massage data into the shape required, creating datasets, reports, and dashboards to meet requirements.

- Present and gather feedback from stakeholders.

- Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Data Analysis tools, developing reports according to analyst-defined specifications.

- Maintain and document the operational environment.


Requirements:


- At least 3 years of experience developing Business Intelligence dashboards and reports, analyzing, and visualizing data.

- An understanding of top-of-the-line Data Analysis tools. Previous experience with administration, licensing, security, and deployment is a plus.

- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.

- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.

- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Video Production Operations Lead - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Production Operations Lead - Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us


Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.


At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.


Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.


Role Overview


As the Team Lead for Portuguese Sketches, you oversee the end-to-end production workflow, ensuring high-quality, scalable, and timely delivery of localized content. You lead a cross-functional team and ensure alignment between English and Portuguese Sketches while maintaining strict audio, visual, and subtitle quality standards.


In addition to overseeing production workflow, this role functions as a key operational stabilizer within the Portuguese content ecosystem. The Team lead ensures asset readiness, prevents production bottlenecks, bridges cross-time-zone collaboration, and safeguards content integrity across localized adaptations, enabling consistent and reliable execution at scale.


Key Responsibilities


Leadership & Workflow Management


  • Team Leadership & Workflow Management: Assign daily tasks, prioritize deliverables, and ensure smooth coordination across Video Editors and QC Specialists.


  • Production Continuity Ownership: Ensure editors are never blocked due to missing assets, incomplete folders, or lack of resource preparation. Proactively prepare videos, audios, scripts, and subtitles before daily production begins.


  • Cross-Team Asset Coordination: Act as liaison between Spanish/Portugeuse production, US content teams, and India stakeholders to request, follow up, and secure required assets in a timely manner.


  • Process Standardization: Develop and maintain internal documentation (SOPs, transition guides, tracking frameworks) to support workflow clarity, team alignment, and smooth leadership transitions.



Reporting, Assets & Documentation


  • Reporting & Performance Tracking: Submit daily performance reports and monitor output, quality, and timelines.


  • Asset & Process Management: Oversee asset organization, repository accuracy, and workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and scalability.


  • Repository & Documentation Management : Maintain structured asset repositories, matching sheets, and tracking documents to ensure transparency and avoid duplication, inconsistencies, or production gaps.


Quality & Content Oversight


  • Quality Oversight: Ensure full synchronization between visuals, audio, and subtitles; consistent visual style; complete audio mix (vocals, music, SFX); and no unintended logos or asset errors.
  • English–Portuguese Alignment: Maintain narrative and visual coherence between source and localized content.
  • Content Integrity Assurance: Monitor alignment between English source content and Portuguese localized assets across motion episodes, still episodes, promo videos, and thumbnails to ensure narrative coherence and platform consistency.


Operations & Issue Resolution


  • Technical Issue Resolution: Address audio/video sync issues, asset inconsistencies, and day-to-day production challenges.


  • Daily Operational Troubleshooting: Resolve audio inconsistencies, subtitle mismatches, CMS issues, visual discrepancies, and asset errors to maintain high production standards.


Reporting, Assets & Documentation


  • Reporting & Performance Tracking: Submit daily performance reports and monitor output, quality, and timelines.


  • Asset & Process Management: Oversee asset organization, repository accuracy, and workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and scalability.


  • Repository & Documentation Management: Maintain structured asset repositories, matching sheets, and tracking documents to ensure transparency and avoid duplication, inconsistencies, or production gaps.


Operations & Issue Resolution


  • Technical Issue Resolution: Address audio/video sync issues, asset inconsistencies, and day-to-day production challenges.
  • Daily Operational Troubleshooting: Resolve audio inconsistencies, subtitle mismatches, CMS issues, visual discrepancies, and asset errors to maintain high production standards.
  • Risk Prevention & Escalation: Identify operational risks (delays, inconsistencies, technical issues) early and escalate proactively to prevent impact on timelines and overall production output.



Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Audio Production, Linguistics, Media, or a related field.
  • Intermediate to advanced English proficiency, with advanced knowledge of Portuguese grammar and orthography.
  • Proven experience in quality control, audio/video production, or a related content operations role.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Suite (including Premiere); familiarity with CMS platforms required. Experience reviewing AI-generated content is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail with a critical eye for audiovisual quality and consistency.
  • Demonstrated leadership and team management experience.
  • Excellent organizational, prioritization, and time management skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Demonstrated ability to act as operational backbone in high-volume content environments, ensuring production continuity and workflow stability.
  • Proven experience anticipating production risks (asset gaps, sync inconsistencies, narrative misalignment) and implementing preventive solutions before escalation.
  • Strong cross-cultural communication skills, with experience bridging expectations between international stakeholders (e.g., US and India teams) and local production teams.
  • Experience building structured documentation, repositories, and tracking systems that enhance team clarity and reduce operational friction.
  • Ability to maintain narrative and technical coherence despite creative divergence across markets.
  • High level of ownership and accountability over end-to-end production outcomes.
  • Strategic operational mindset with the ability to balance creative integrity, technical precision, and workflow efficiency.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.


Salary for this position is R$7,000 - $10,000 BRL.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Graphic Designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

We are…

A digital sports media group with an innovative approach and fan-first mentality, we're redefining how sports content is consumed and shared.

Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. Whether you are a sports fan or just curious, EMP is the place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.

You Are...

An experienced and driven graphic design professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

﻿

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Graphic Designer. The Graphic Designer will be responsible for creating visual content including graphics, logos, branding materials, and typography designs. You will collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement creative concepts and ensure brand consistency across all platforms. Daily tasks will include brainstorming ideas, executing design projects, and refining designs based on feedback.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Graphic Design and Graphics
  • Experience in Logo Design and Branding
  • Skills in Typography
  • Strong attention to detail and creativity
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Proficiency with design software such as Adobe Creative Suite
  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related field
  • Experience in digital media or marketing is a plus
  • Proficiency in English, spoken and written.

description:

Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) Civil para atuar como líder técnico e gestor de equipe de projetistas. Este profissional será responsável pela condução técnica de projetos de subestações de alta tensão (69 kV e 138 kV), incluindo terraplenagem, drenagem, bases e fundações, cálculos estruturais, casas de comendo e urbanização, garantindo o alinhamento entre qualidade, prazos e resultados esperados.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar e orientar equipe de projetistas na elaboração e revisão de projetos;
  • Coordenar atividades técnicas envolvendo projetos de subestações de alta tensão;
  • Realizar o planejamento e o acompanhamento de cronogramas dos projetos;
  • Garantir a qualidade técnica das entregas e o cumprimento dos prazos definidos;
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas com clientes e equipe interna;
  • Apoiar a padronização de processos e a melhoria contínua da área de engenharia;


Qualificações e Requisitos

  • Formação completa em Engenharia Civil;

About us

Clickbait Agency is a YouTube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on YouTube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.

We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script YouTube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.

We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet.
